entities.summary:
Rizal Technological University (RTU) is a state university based in the National Capital Region of the Philippines, with its main campus in Mandaluyong City and a branch in Pasig City. It was established on July 11, 1969, as the College of Rizal, before it became autonomous in 1975. The state university is also the first educational institution in the country to use cooperative education as a curriculum plan which is recognized by various industries, businesses and agencies all over the country.

The university has various different academic fields, and focuses primarily on architecture, engineering, and technology programs. Rizal Technological University is a university in Asia, established in 1969-07-11. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Rizal Technological University's adoption of cooperative education has had a significant impact on the Philippines' workforce development, with over 90% of its graduates finding employment within six months of graduation. This model has been recognized internationally and has influenced educational institutions in Southeast Asia.
